title: Luggage storage in Rome with Radical Storage

summary: Radical Storage's Rome page for leaving bags with local partners near the main sights and stations, from €1.60.
body:
## What this listing is

Radical Storage is a booking service for luggage storage. Its Rome page lets you pick a nearby partner, book a drop-off online and leave your bags for the day. The page's title reads "Luggage Storage Rome from €1.60/Day | 282 Locations". It says there are 282 locations in Rome.

## How it works

The page lays out four steps: find a verified storage point nearby, book online and receive the confirmation, show that confirmation when you drop the bags, then collect them whenever you like. Radical Storage describes its partners as local businesses such as shops, cafés and hotels, so opening hours follow each business.

## What it costs

The listing's headline price is from €1.60. The example location shown was Termini Hotel, open 24 hours, at €3.90 a bag a day, with a rating of 4.7 (6,027 reviews). Prices differ by location and by how many days you store, so open a specific location before relying on the headline figure.

## Where you can store

The page lists these popular areas in Rome: Roma Termini, Pantheon, Vatican, Trastevere, Roma Tiburtina, Castel Sant'Angelo, Trevi, Navona Square, Colosseum, Monti. If your plan is tied to one of them, searching from that area shows the closest points.

## What the company promises

Across all its locations the page shows a rating of 4.8 out of 5 from 669,000 reviews, a €10,000 guarantee, and free cancellation. These are the company's own figures for the whole service, not for one Rome location.

## When it helps

It suits a day at the Vatican or the Colosseum after checking out and before a late departure from Termini. If you travel with bags only for a short time, compare the per-bag price with the lockers at the station you are using.
